title: Choose a query that matches the data contract
description: Pick an extraction goal, then compare candidate Beautiful Soup queries. The highlighted nodes, return shape, and downstream consequence change together.

missions.label: Collect every product card
missions.detail: The caller expects a collection and will iterate over it.

options.label: Scoped CSS selector
options.consequence: The plural method returns both product cards and the selector encodes the product class, so an unrelated article would not silently enter the dataset.

options.label: First matching product
options.consequence: The query stops after the first match. Iteration code receives one Tag instead of the complete product collection.

options.label: Every article element
options.consequence: It happens to match the sample, but it does not encode the product boundary. A future editorial article would be accepted as product data.

missions.label: Read the featured product price
missions.detail: The caller expects one optional price from the featured card.

options.label: Feature-scoped price
options.consequence: The selector first identifies the featured card and then its price. The caller can explicitly handle None when the optional feature is absent.

options.label: Every price on the page
options.consequence: The query returns a collection from every product. Taking an arbitrary item later hides which product the value belongs to.

options.label: First price element
options.consequence: The return shape is singular, but document order selects the desk lamp rather than the featured task chair.

missions.label: Collect product titles only
missions.detail: The page also contains a support heading that must stay out of the result.

options.label: Titles inside product cards
options.consequence: The query encodes both the product boundary and the title relationship, excluding the support heading.

options.label: Every level-two heading
options.consequence: A structural heading from the support area enters the product dataset because the query has no product scope.

options.label: First level-two heading
options.consequence: The query returns a valid title but silently drops the second product, violating the collection contract.
